8:echo "METRIC tests_passed=$(echo "$tests" | sed -n 's/^ℹ pass //p')"
9:mkdir -p .omp
10:node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings bench/critic/bench.ts --json "${BENCH_JSON:-.omp/critic-bench.json}" | grep '^METRIC\|^WRONG\|^MISSING'
11:if [[ -n "${CRITIC_BENCH_LLM_LABEL:-}" ]]; then
12:  node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings bench/critic/llm.ts --label "$CRITIC_BENCH_LLM_LABEL" --concurrency 6
13:fi
